ui.title: Protection of the Spheres
ui.title.tagline: Two sides, three lanes, one Sphere each. Push the creeps, take the towers, break the other side's Sphere.
ui.title.fine: A browser game in the manner of the Warcraft III map Defense of the Ancients. Every hero and item here is original.
ui.arcade.title: Arcade
ui.arcade.custom.text: Choose the size of each side and how well each side's computer players play.
ui.mode.aram.text: Each player is dealt a random hero and may reroll before the start. All ten fight in the middle lane, and a cannon at each base throws heroes back to it.
ui.pick.title: Choose your hero
ui.heroes.title: Heroes
ui.pick.hint: Choose a hero to see their abilities.
ui.pick.rerolled: Your reroll is spent, so this hero is yours.
ui.pick.no_reroll: Rerolls come with All Random All Mid. Switch the mode on in the custom match to use one.
ui.pick.random: This mode deals your hero. Reroll for another.
ui.tip.secret: Sold only at the secret shop.
ui.tip.courier: Your courier brings it from the base.
ui.hud.aim: Choose a target. Right-click to cancel.
ui.hud.aim_attack: Attack-move: choose a point or a unit.
ui.hud.aim_cannon: Choose where to land on the lane. Right-click to cancel.
ui.cannon.not_ready: The cannon fires from the fountain, once each visit. Walk back to load it.
ui.hud.learn: Learn: press Q, W, E or R, or T for the attribute bonus.
ui.hud.stats_bonus.title: Attribute bonus
ui.hud.stats_bonus.text: Adds to strength, agility and intelligence. Any level may take it.
ui.shop.title: Shop
ui.shop.choose: Choose an item to see what it is built from.
ui.shop.carried: You carry this part: it is counted in the price.

ui.menu.title: Paused
ui.help.title: How to play
ui.help.1: Right-click the ground to walk there. Right-click an enemy to attack it.
ui.help.2: Gold comes from the killing blow. Land the last hit on enemy creeps to earn it.
ui.help.3: Below half health your own creeps can be denied: kill them yourself so the enemy gets no gold.
ui.help.4: Q, W, E and R use your abilities. A targeted ability waits for a click; right-click cancels.
ui.help.5: Each level gives one point. Press O, then an ability key, or click the plus under an ability.
ui.help.6: Press B for the shop. Away from the base, your courier carries what you buy.
ui.help.7: Towers fall in order down each lane. The Sphere can be hurt only after both towers beside it fall.
ui.help.8: Attacking an enemy hero near enemy creeps or a tower turns them on you. Spells do not.
ui.help.9: Space centres the camera on your hero. Move the pointer to the screen's edge to look around.
ui.help.10: A rune appears in the river every second minute. Walk over it to take it.
ui.help.11: The Warden waits in a pit by the river. Defeat it for a shield that saves its holder from one death.
ui.help.12: Press A, then click, to attack-move. Press S to stop and H to hold position.
ui.online.title: Online
ui.online.relays: Online play introduces browsers through public relays this game does not run, then connects them directly. Nothing loads from another site until you host or join.
ui.online.host_text: Open a room and share its code. Up to ten players; computer players fill the empty seats.
ui.online.bad_code: Type the room code the host shared.
ui.online.all_pick: Every player must choose a hero first.
ui.online.waiting: In the room. Waiting for the host to start.
ui.online.connecting: Looking for the room through the relays.
ui.online.catching: Catching up with the match. Your hero rejoins in a moment.
ui.online.host_left: The host left. The match cannot go on without the host's browser.
ui.online.garbled: A message from another browser could not be read.
ui.online.reload: The other browser runs a different version. Reload the page.
ui.online.full: The room is full, or the match has started without a seat for you.
ui.online.desync: The browsers' matches no longer agree. Leave and start again.
ui.online.no_relay: No relay answered. Check the connection and try again.
ui.online.no_path: The two browsers could not reach each other directly. A network on either side may block it.
ui.online.no_bundle: The online code could not load. Reload the page.
ui.online.signal_failed: The connection could not be set up. Try again.
ui.menu.autopilot_on: Let the computer play my hero
ui.hud.autopilot: The computer is playing your hero.

first_steps.name: First steps
first_steps.title: Land {target} last hits within {minutes} minutes
first_steps.text: One quiet enemy and one lane. Watch a creep's health and strike as it drops low enough for one hit.

the_tower.name: The tower
the_tower.title: Destroy {target} enemy tower
the_tower.text: Push your creeps into the enemy tower. Let them take its first shots, and step back when it turns on you.

spells.name: Spells and stuns
spells.title: Kill the enemy hero {target} times
spells.text: Use your abilities on the enemy hero. A stun followed by attacks wins most fights early on.

shopping.name: Shopping
shopping.title: Destroy {target} enemy towers
shopping.text: Buy as you go. Boots first, then an item that suits your hero. Your courier brings what you buy away from the base.

two_lanes.name: Two lanes
two_lanes.title: Break the enemy Sphere
two_lanes.text: An ally joins you against two enemies. Win your lane, then push together.

ganks.name: Ganks
ganks.title: Break the enemy Sphere
ganks.text: Three against three. Leave your lane to catch an enemy hero alone with your allies.

the_warden.name: The Warden
the_warden.title: Defeat the Warden {target} time
the_warden.text: Gather your side and fight the Warden in its pit by the river. Its shield saves the holder from one death.

full_five.name: Five against five
full_five.title: Break the enemy Sphere
full_five.text: A full match against computer players of normal skill.

hard_five.name: Hard five
hard_five.title: Break the enemy Sphere
hard_five.text: A full match against skilled computer players.

unfair.name: Unfair
unfair.title: Break the enemy Sphere
unfair.text: The enemy's computer players react at once and land almost every last hit.

ironvow.name: Ironvow
ironvow.title: The Sworn Blade
ironvow.text: A plate knight who swore his greatsword to a cause and never set it down. He opens fights with a stun and wins them by cutting through packed enemies.

rime.name: Rime
rime.title: Hermit of the Frost
rime.text: A frost hermit who left the cold peaks with a crystal staff. She slows and freezes enemies from behind her allies and keeps their mana flowing.

cinder.name: Cinder
cinder.title: The Ember Dancer
cinder.text: A fire dancer with burning hands who turns every spell into speed. She lands heavy magic damage in quick bursts and finishes heroes from range.

thistle.name: Thistle
thistle.title: The Silent Bow
thistle.text: A hooded archer whose arrows carry frost. She slows enemies with each shot, silences their casters and grows stronger the longer she attacks.

gristle.name: Gristle
gristle.title: The Stitched Butcher
gristle.text: A stitched butcher who drags his prey in with a hook. He pulls a lone enemy out of position and holds it while he feeds.

tectus.name: Tectus
tectus.title: Hornbreaker
tectus.text: A horned stone ox-man who speaks through the ground. He splits the earth to trap enemies and punishes groups that stand together.

kestrel.name: Kestrel
kestrel.title: The Masked Edge
kestrel.text: A masked bladedancer with a curved sword. He spins through fights immune to spells and ends them with a flurry of strikes no one can stop.

hexwright.name: Hexwright
hexwright.title: The Gaunt Curse
hexwright.text: A gaunt warlock with a clawed staff and a long list of grudges. He locks down one enemy after another and kills with a single bolt.

longwick.name: Longwick
longwick.title: The Patient Rifle
longwick.text: A gnome marksman with a rifle twice his height. He shoots from farther than anyone else and picks off wounded heroes across the map.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.title: Keeper of Storms
tempest.text: An old storm caller crowned with cloud. His lightning chains through enemies, and his last word strikes every enemy hero at once.

storm_bolt.name: Vow Hammer
storm_bolt.text: Hurls a hammer at an enemy. Enemies within {radius} of the target take {damage} magic damage and are stunned for {stun:s} seconds.

great_cleave.name: Wide Arc
great_cleave.text: Melee attacks also hit enemies within {radius} of the target for {pct:%} of their damage.

warcry.name: Rallying Shout
warcry.text: Allied heroes within {radius} gain {armor} armor and {move_pct:%} move speed for {duration:s} seconds.

gods_strength.name: Iron Oath
gods_strength.text: Raises attack damage by {damage_pct:%} for {duration:s} seconds.

crystal_nova.name: Hoarfrost Burst
crystal_nova.text: Blasts enemies within {radius} of a point for {damage} magic damage. They are slowed by {slow:%} move speed and {attack_slow} attack speed for {duration:s} seconds.

frostbite.name: Ice Shackle
frostbite.text: Freezes an enemy in place for {duration:s} seconds. It cannot move or attack, and it loses {damage} health over that time.

brilliance_aura.name: Clear Mind
brilliance_aura.text: Allied heroes anywhere on the map regain {regen:s} extra mana a second.

freezing_field.name: Winter's Ring
freezing_field.text: Channels for up to {duration:s} seconds. Every {interval:s} seconds, an ice blast lands between {inner} and {outer} from Rime and hits enemies within {blast} of it.

dragon_slave.name: Flame Wave
dragon_slave.text: Sends a wave of fire {length} forward. Each enemy it passes through takes {damage} magic damage.

light_strike_array.name: Pillar of Flame
light_strike_array.text: After {delay:s} seconds, fire strikes the ground. Enemies within {radius} take {damage} magic damage and are stunned for {stun:s} seconds.

fiery_soul.name: Kindled Step
fiery_soul.text: Each spell Cinder casts gives her {attack_speed} attack speed and {move_pct:%} move speed for {duration:s} seconds. Stacks up to {stacks} times.

laguna_blade.name: Searing Lance
laguna_blade.text: After {delay:s} seconds, a lance of fire strikes one enemy for {damage} magic damage.

frost_arrows.name: Rimed Arrows
frost_arrows.text: While on, each attack on an enemy costs mana and slows it by {slow:%} for {duration:s} seconds.

silence.name: Hush
silence.text: Silences enemies within {radius} of a point for {duration:s} seconds. Silenced units cannot cast spells.

trueshot_aura.name: Hunter's Eye
trueshot_aura.text: Ranged allies within {radius} gain {pct:%} of their base attack damage.

meat_hook.name: Gutting Hook
meat_hook.text: Throws a hook in a line. The first unit it hits is dragged back to Gristle, and an enemy takes {damage} pure damage.

rot.name: Carrion Cloud
rot.text: While on, enemies within {radius} take {dps} magic damage a second and are slowed by {slow:%}. Gristle takes the same damage.

flesh_heap.name: Grave Bulk
flesh_heap.text: Gives {resist:%} magic resistance. Each enemy hero that dies within {radius} of Gristle adds {str:s} strength for the rest of the game.

dismember.name: Butcher's Feast
dismember.text: Channels on an enemy for up to {duration:s} seconds. The enemy is stunned and takes {dps} magic damage a second.

fissure.name: Rift Stomp
fissure.text: Splits the ground in a line {length} long. Enemies in it take {damage} magic damage and are stunned for {stun:s} seconds. Rocks block the line for {duration:s} seconds.

enchant_totem.name: Horn Charge
enchant_totem.text: Tectus's next attack within {duration:s} seconds deals {damage_pct:%} extra damage.

aftershock.name: Ground Tremor
aftershock.text: Each spell Tectus casts deals {damage} magic damage to enemies within {radius} and stuns them for {stun:s} seconds.

echo_slam.name: Resonant Slam
echo_slam.text: Deals {damage} magic damage to enemies within {radius}. Each enemy hit takes {echo} more for every other enemy hit.

blade_fury.name: Whirling Edge
blade_fury.text: Kestrel spins for {duration:s} seconds, dealing {dps} magic damage a second to enemies within {radius}. Spells cannot affect him while he spins, and he cannot attack.

healing_ward.name: Mending Totem
healing_ward.text: Places a totem that follows Kestrel for {duration:s} seconds. Allies within {radius} of it regain {heal_pct:%} of their maximum health a second.

blade_dance.name: Keen Edge
blade_dance.text: Each attack has a {chance:%} chance to deal {multiplier:x} damage.

omnislash.name: Thousand Cuts
omnislash.text: Kestrel leaps between enemies within {radius} up to {jumps} times, one strike every {interval:s} seconds. Each strike deals {min} to {max} physical damage, and he cannot be harmed until it ends.

earth_spike.name: Thornburst
earth_spike.text: Spikes erupt in a line {length} long. Enemies hit take {damage} magic damage and are stunned for {stun:s} seconds.

hex.name: Toadcurse
hex.text: Turns an enemy into a harmless critter for {duration:s} seconds. It cannot attack or cast spells.

mana_drain.name: Soul Siphon
mana_drain.text: Channels on an enemy for up to {duration:s} seconds, taking {drain} mana a second from it. The link breaks if the enemy moves farther than {break} away or runs out of mana.

finger_of_death.name: Final Verdict
finger_of_death.text: After {delay:s} seconds, deals {damage} magic damage to one enemy.

shrapnel.name: Scattershot
shrapnel.text: After {delay:s} seconds, shot rains on an area for {duration:s} seconds. Enemies within {radius} take {dps} magic damage a second and are slowed by {slow:%}.

headshot.name: Clean Shot
headshot.text: Each attack has a {chance:%} chance to deal {damage} extra physical damage and stun the target for {stun:s} seconds.

assassinate.name: Deadeye
assassinate.text: Takes careful aim, then fires at one enemy. The shot deals {damage} magic damage and stuns for {stun:s} seconds.

arc_lightning.name: Forked Spark
arc_lightning.text: Strikes an enemy for {damage} magic damage, then leaps to the nearest enemy within {radius}. It hits up to {bounces} enemies.

lightning_bolt.name: Skyfall Bolt
lightning_bolt.text: Strikes an enemy for {damage} magic damage and stuns it for {stun:s} seconds.

static_field.name: Charged Air
static_field.text: Each spell Tempest casts takes {pct:%} of the current health of each enemy within {radius} as magic damage.

thundergods_wrath.name: Stormcall
thundergods_wrath.text: Strikes every living enemy hero on the map for {damage} magic damage.

warden_bash.name: Crushing Blow
warden_bash.text: Each attack has a {chance:%} chance to deal {damage} extra magic damage and stun the target for {stun:s} seconds.

tango.name: Sapling Chew
tango.text: Eat a tree within {range} to restore {heal} health over {duration:s} seconds. Holds {charges} uses.

salve.name: Poultice
salve.text: Restores {heal} health to an ally over {duration:s} seconds.

clarity.name: Stillwater Draught
clarity.text: Restores {mana} mana to an ally over {duration:s} seconds.

tp.name: Waystone
tp.text: Moves your hero to the allied building nearest the chosen point.

observer.name: Watching Eye
observer.text: Places an unseen ward that gives sight of the area around it for {duration:s} seconds. Holds {charges} wards.

sentry.name: Seeker's Ward
sentry.text: Places an unseen ward for {duration:s} seconds that reveals unseen enemies within {true_sight}. Holds {charges} wards.

bottle.name: Fountain Flask
bottle.text: Restores {heal} health and {mana} mana over {duration:s} seconds. Holds {charges} draughts and refills at your fountain.

magic_stick.name: Echo Rod
magic_stick.text: Gains a charge each time an enemy hero casts a spell within {radius}, up to {max}. Use it to restore {per_charge} health and mana for each charge.

blink.name: Skipstone
blink.text: Moves your hero up to {range} to the chosen point. It cannot be used for {damage_lock:s} seconds after an enemy hero deals damage to you.

magic_wand.name: Echo Wand
magic_wand.text: Gains a charge each time an enemy hero casts a spell within {radius}, up to {max}. Use it to restore {per_charge} health and mana for each charge.

travel_boots.name: Wayfarer Boots
travel_boots.text: Moves your hero to the allied building nearest the chosen point.

midas.name: Gilded Palm
midas.text: Kills an enemy or neutral creep. You gain {gold} gold and {xp_pct:%} of its usual experience.

mekansm.name: Mender's Engine
mekansm.text: Heals allies within {radius} for {heal} health and gives them {armor} armor for {duration:s} seconds.

bkb.name: Spellward Seal
bkb.text: Makes your hero immune to spells for {duration:s} seconds.

heart.name: Heart of the Mountain
heart.text: Restores {regen_pct:%} of maximum health a second.

shivas.name: Frostward Mail
shivas.text: Sends out a wave that deals {damage} magic damage to enemies within {radius}. They are slowed by {slow:%} for {duration:s} seconds.

assault.name: Siegebreaker Plate
assault.text: Allies within {radius} gain {armor} armor and {attack_speed} attack speed.

battlefury.name: Reaping Axe
battlefury.text: Melee attacks also hit enemies within {radius} of the target for {pct:%} of their damage.

crystalys.name: Shardblade
crystalys.text: Each attack has a {chance:%} chance to deal {multiplier:x} damage.

daedalus.name: Ruin Bow
daedalus.text: Each attack has a {chance:%} chance to deal {multiplier:x} damage.

mkb.name: Thunderclap Staff
mkb.text: Each attack has a {chance:%} chance to deal {damage} extra physical damage and stun the target for {stun:s} seconds.

basher.name: Skull Mace
basher.text: Melee attacks have a {chance:%} chance to stun the target for {stun:s} seconds. Ranged attacks have a {ranged_chance:%} chance.

desolator.name: Corroding Blade
desolator.text: Each attack lowers the target's armor by {armor} for {duration:s} seconds.

maelstrom.name: Stormlash
maelstrom.text: Each attack has a {chance:%} chance to release lightning. It deals {damage} magic damage and leaps between enemies within {radius}, hitting up to {bounces}.

mjollnir.name: Thunder Maul
mjollnir.text: Each attack has a {chance:%} chance to release lightning. It deals {damage} magic damage and leaps between enemies within {radius}, hitting up to {bounces}.

radiance.name: Sunflare
radiance.text: Burns enemies within {radius} for {dps} magic damage a second.

manta.name: Shadow Mantle
manta.text: Splits your hero into illusions that last {duration:s} seconds. They deal {dealt:%} of your damage and take {taken:%} damage.

dagon.name: Soulfire Rod
dagon.text: Deals {damage} magic damage to an enemy.

euls.name: Cyclone Staff
euls.text: Lifts a unit into the air for {duration:s} seconds. It cannot act or be harmed until it lands.

force_staff.name: Gust Rod
force_staff.text: Pushes a unit {distance} in the direction it faces.

sheep.name: Toad Staff
sheep.text: Turns an enemy into a harmless critter for {duration:s} seconds.

aegis.name: Second Dawn
aegis.text: Saves the holder from death once. The hero rises in place at full health and mana after {delay:s} seconds.
